connections.why: Main 2in line from FROM PRU SEPARATOR connector (bottom-left) runs right, then up x~689 to the horizontal at y~2094 feeding X-2503 inlet.
FROM PHENOLIC WASTE WATER PUMPS 25-0013 (arrow points left, y~2918) -> PWHT line up x~965 -> tee into main at y~2535. Joins main (not direct to mixer).
FROM OEC ACID INJECTION PUMPS 25-0010 (y~2806) -> 1/2in SA line up x~1160 -> reducer -> tee into main at y~2378. Joins main.

Branch off main at y~2719 (gate valve) -> down arrow x~815 -> east to TO PHENOLIC WASTE WATER TANK 25-0013 (the lower of the 3 right-edge 25-0013 connectors, y~3034, arrow pointing right). Id PC/25-0013 has several copies; this one is the 'to' copy at y~3034.
3in TFE2 line from mixer outlet to vessel bottom nozzle DW.
3in bypass around X-2503 (valve in bypass); line number of bypass not printed separately (3in leader only), taken as 25-006002 [ASSUMPTION].
Main 3in line from D-2506 AM up the vertical x~1860 past FIF/AE to TO OIL EXTRACTION COLUMN 25-0007A at y~645 (the connector at y~645, not the signal connector at y~219).
Riser A (1.5in, 007003 printed vertically beside it) from header y~1643 up to PSV 0702A inlet. PSV is a terminal; inlet side.
Riser B (1.5in, 007004 leader points at it) from header up to PSV 0702B inlet.
PSV 0702A outlet -> 2in F line 007005 -> UC 25-0017 (F box).
PSV 0702B outlet -> up x~2408 (007006 leader) -> joins 007005 junction -> UC 25-0017.

not_connected.why: Both are instrument signal lines (circle-chain, FT/FIC/AIC) leaving the same instruments; no pipe between them.
25-0010 'TO ANALYZER SWITCH' is a circle-chain instrument signal from AIC 0702 (PC/25-0010 also has a pipe 'from' copy that belongs to the lower-left network, not to AM).
Top and bottom nozzles of the same vessel; connection is through the vessel, not by pipe.
Upper process network and lower feed network are separate; only link is through D-2506 (vessel), not pipe.
Upper PSV/F-header network vs lower mixer outlet; separated by the vessel D-2506.
